name: RapidBlogAI
author: webthreex

sections.description:
RapidBlogAI revolutionizes WordPress blogging by turning simple keywords and site info into full, human-like blog posts powered by advanced AI models like GPT-4o. Ideal for busy site owners, agencies, and niches like moving companies or e-commerce, it delivers keyword-rich content ready for one-click publishing—boosting SEO without the writing hassle. Start with unlimited free generations (API key required) and upgrade to Pro for social post automation, image gen, and analytics.

This plugin sends data to third-party AI services (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Perplexity) for content generation. Ensure you comply with their terms of service.

Features:
– Generate 1-5 posts per scheduled run
– Schedule generation at any time of day (HH:MM format)
– Choose post status (Draft, Publish, Pending, Private)
– Auto-create categories for generated posts
– Support for multiple AI models: OpenAI GPT-3.5 Turbo, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Perplexity AI
– Custom keywords for content generation
– Manual generation option
– Beautiful, modern admin interface

External services

This plugin integrates with the following third-party AI services to generate content:

  1. OpenAI API (https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions)

    • Used for: Generating SEO-optimized blog posts using GPT models.
    • Data sent: Keywords, site details, and content generation prompts.
    • When: Only when the user initiates content generation (manual or scheduled).
    • Terms of service: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
    • Privacy policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

  2. Anthropic Claude API (https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages)

    • Used for: Generating SEO-optimized blog posts using Claude models.
    • Data sent: Keywords, site details, and content generation prompts.
    • When: Only when the user initiates content generation (manual or scheduled).
    • Terms of service: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms
    • Privacy policy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy

  3. Google Gemini API (https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-flash-latest:generateContent)

    • Used for: Generating SEO-optimized blog posts using Gemini models.
    • Data sent: Keywords, site details, and content generation prompts.
    • When: Only when the user initiates content generation (manual or scheduled).
    • Terms of service: https://ai.google.dev/terms
    • Privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  4. Perplexity AI API (https://api.perplexity.ai/chat/completions)

    • Used for: Generating SEO-optimized blog posts using Perplexity models.
    • Data sent: Keywords, site details, and content generation prompts.
    • When: Only when the user initiates content generation (manual or scheduled).
    • Terms of service: https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/legal/terms-of-service
    • Privacy policy: https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/legal/privacy-policy

All data transmission is initiated by the user and requires a valid API key provided by the user. The plugin does not store or transmit any personal user data beyond what is necessary for content generation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the rapidblogai folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin
  3. Go to Settings > RapidBlogAI to configure
sections.faq:
How does it work?

Enter your keywords, select an AI model, provide an API key, and let the plugin generate posts automatically.

Is it free?

Yes, with unlimited generations (requires API key).
